## What lives here
The UI components, grouped by feature (workflows, rules, remote-servers, ontology and others), plus shared pieces and the shadcn primitives (`ui/`).

## Conventions
Feature folders mirror the pages. Write controls are gated with `lib/policy`. Background work goes through `lib/runs`.

## Entry points
Imported by `src/routes/*`.
